special_assumptions.entry_fill: Next five-minute bar open after a completed signal bar.

hypothesis.behavior: A longer unbroken MES five-minute price run may be more likely to reverse than continue.
edge_reasoning: Tick-level FX deal-price runs showed short continuation, while longer runs tended to be followed by larger reversal; transfer to MES five-minute bars is unproved.
failure_theory: The source market and sampling frequency may not transfer to MES five-minute bars.
Transaction costs and bid-ask effects may eliminate any gross pattern.

implementation_notes.expected_custom_logic: An exact deterministic adapter and immutable StudyPlan compiler are required before execution.

claimed_difference: Exact rules and economics were compared against the gateway prior-work records before submission.

qf_interpretation.entry: Between 10:00 and 14:00 ET, after the selected number of completed same-sign nonzero bars, enter opposite the run at the next bar open.

entry: Enter at the next five-minute bar open after the completed-bar condition.
exit: Force flat at 15:50 ET if an earlier exit has not occurred.
setup: Between 10:00 and 14:00 ET, after the selected number of completed same-sign nonzero bars, enter opposite the run at the next bar open.
